flags.why: This verb means to shift a little, without implying sudden movement ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=x%E1%BB%8Bch)).
flags.fix: to shift or move a little

flags.why: This description of drifting mist or clouds is literary and needs a register warning ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/lang-dang-eWVXFyAlEN4j4.html)).

The verb meaning to steep or soak is dầm, whereas dằm denotes a splinter or a place to sit or lie ([dầm](https://tudientv.com/?t=d%E1%BA%A7m), [dằm](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-d%E1%BA%B1m)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense from dằm and place it under dầm.

flags.why: This term for the glans is commonly vulgar, so colloquial alone does not adequately warn the learner ([dictionary record](https://kaikki.org/viwiktionary/All%20languages%20combined/pos-noun/%C4%91%E1%BA%A5u--%C4%91%E1%BA%B1ng%20ng%C3%A0.html)).
